Dialogs.Dialog: Time flies when you're having fun, we're here.
It really does. Isn't that a good thing？
No need to rush, we've still got time.
I want to stay together longer, but I guess we can't.
Same here, ●... but we should head back soon.
I want to stay longer too... but it's time.
Sorry, I actually heard you. Aw... such a shame.
We should head back around now.
Really？ Aw, man... That went by so fast.
Ah... is our time up already？
Ah, you're right. Shall we go？
Yeah. We'd better wrap things up for today.
Hey, it's about time to head back...
I know. Come on, shall we head back？
I'd love for you to take the lead.
Then let's go wherever you pick, okay？
Where do you wanna go？ Tell me？
I can't decide. Could you pick for us？
Just thinking about it like this is fun, too.
Yeah. Keep leading me gently, just like that.
Want to check out somewhere else？
Anywhere's fine, as long as we have fun together.
Let's see, where we're heading next is...
Time for my boyfriend to show what he's got.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, where do you want to go next？
Well then... I want to go wherever you choose.
See anything good？ Which one should we see？
Hard to choose which one to watch...
Same here. How about you be a man and make the call？ Okay？
Which movie do you want to see？
They all look interesting. Pick whichever you like.
Which one do you want to see, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I'm fine with whatever... You choose, okay？
The one ● wants to see is...
Which one？ Did you think about what I'd like, too？
I wonder which movie would be good...
Take your time and think about it before deciding, okay？
Is there any movie you want to see？
I'm fine either way... Whichever you pick.
If it's boring, though, you're getting punished.
I kind of hope you make up your mind soon.
Phew... That really was a lot of fun.
I think I kinda want to watch another one. Can we？
Yeah, let's watch another one, then！
Me too. ...Wanna stay for one more？
Now I'm starting to feel like watching another one...
Hey, since we're here, how about one more...？
Really？ Well, let's go ahead and do it, then.
How about staying to watch another one？
Oh, all right. I'll keep you company.
Yeah, I was thinking that'd be good, too.
I'm with you. Looks like it'll be fun.
Yeah, sounds good to me, too.
That's a bit... No, let's give it a shot？
There？ I don't mind, I guess, but...
...I can get my hopes up, right？
Oh, me too. Wanna get some lunch？
▲主人公＊▲. Isn't it about time for lunch？
Let's take a quick break, then. Time to get some food.
Aren't you hungry？ Wanna go grab a bite？
Hold on! It's lunchtime, so let's go eat, okay？
Sorry, I think my stomach just growled...
Guess there's no helping it. Lunch it is, then!
I want to take a break and catch my breath... Okay？
Sure. Let's find a cafe, then.
Aren't you thirsty？ I'd love to rest a bit, too.
I'm getting kind of thirsty. How about you？
Yeah... Want to grab a drink somewhere？
Yeah, want to grab a drink？
...I'd really love to grab a drink.
...Phew. I'd love to sit down and relax for a bit.
Oh, want to head to a cafe, then？
Hey, aren't you getting hungry by now？
I thought we'd have dinner together today, though？
By the way, where should we go for dinner？
Is it that time already？ All right, let's go.
Um... Aren't we having dinner today？
Hey, aren't you forgetting something？ Look at the time!
Um... dinner, right？ Let's go grab a bite.
I'd hate to head home on an empty stomach...
Chatting makes the time fly. Look, we're already here!
We're here. Do you know what you're getting？
This place？ Shall we go in？
We've gotten pretty hungry, haven't we？
Can I be a little selfish？ I don't want our date to end...
Hey, I could stay out a little longer, you know？
I don't want to leave you just yet... Please？
Hey... Will you take me somewhere else, too？
Oh my. Looks like my watch stopped. We still have time, right？
We can stay together a little longer, right？
●, I want to stay with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ a bit longer.
Look at you, being sweet. Well... I guess I'll keep you company.
For now, let's head somewhere else.
Can we... keep our date going？
Geez. Like I could ever turn you down？ Where are we going？
...Right. You've got things to do, after all.
...Did I put you on the spot？ Don't worry about it, then.
Got it. Make sure you show me a good time, okay？
Leave it to me! Alright, let's head out!
Going there would take too long, huh... Sorry about that.
Maybe we should save that place for another day？
Ah... the time, huh. It's already pretty late.
That's true... Ah, but the time...
Ah... right, that place is pretty far.
...Sorry. I really do have to head home.
There？ ...Sorry, but can we call off what I just said？
Hmm... Maybe we should just head home for today？
